name: Aether Current keeps feather fall and water walking but not hover (#5335)
contract: Issue #5335: Aether Current 531512 applied FEATHER_FALL (105), HOVER (106) and WATER_WALK (104) together. HOVER switches the client to altitude-hold physics, which is why directional steering stopped working while falling.
The spell is bound to spell_ascension_stormbringer_aether_current, which prevents the EFFECT_1 HOVER aura from applying. After one cast the caster must carry 105 and 104 and must not carry 106.

steps.label: Let login and class synchronisation settle
